tldr: DeepSeek's official V4-Flash-0731 release details land — the post-training-only upgrade beats V4-Pro preview on every published agentic benchmark at a third of the output price, adds DSpark speculative decoding, native Responses API + Codex support, MIT-licensed and ungated. OpenAI published 'Ten Advances in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science,' an unusually concrete research post that hit the top of HN. Legal news: a Munich court ruled Suno violated copyright in both training and output, rejecting fair-use defenses — the first major European loss for a music-gen AI. Anthropic shipped the MCP 2026-07-28 spec (stateless core, OAuth 2.0 hardening) and the Amodeis gave a revealing interview: a capability-jump model codenamed Mythos is restricted to ~40 defenders, and Anthropic refused Pentagon contracts over drone autonomy and mass surveillance. Plus: Encore AI raised $30M for customer-trained voice agents, and the community debates whether small 1B-class LLMs are disappearing and why AI still doesn't ship working products.
